title: fix(spec): rewrite ConditionalValidationSchema TSDoc examples in evaluable CEL (#20026)
body:
Fixes #20026

Clause-②: no

## REWORK round 1 — what changed since the last revision

Per the contract-review FAIL on this PR (comment 5856311938 on this PR, order of record 5856314403 on #20026), three things were wrong and are fixed in this round:

1. **The `matches()` example did not parse when copied.** The docblock's `"^\d{2}-\d{7}$"` reads fine as raw comment text (comments are not JS-escape-processed), but a reader who pastes that literal into a real `.ts` string literal gets ONE level of JS unescaping the comment text never went through: `\\d` in the comment becomes `\d` at runtime, and cel-js refuses `\d` as an invalid escape sequence (it only accepts `\\ ? " ' \` a b f n r t v`, `\u`, `\x`, octal). Rewritten to the escape-free character class `"^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{7}$"`, which needs no escaping at any copy depth. **The previous revision's transcript row for this predicate, and its "20/20 …" claim, were not measured on the copied literal** — see the corrected measurement methodology below.
2. **Two changeset sentences were false at the reviewed head.** "`@marcbachmann/cel-js` parses `=` as the start of an assignment" → cel-js has no assignment operator; it rejects a lone `=` as an unexpected character, and CEL equality is `==`. The "both branches evaluate as expected for all 19" claim and the `matches` table row are now true, after item 1.
3. **Ten more `validation.test.ts` fixtures were left behind under the already-widened scope.** Each one's surrounding test name and message text verbatim-copy a Use Case 4/5/6/7 docblock predicate the same way the original seven did, so the PR's own stated criterion for moving a fixture applies to them too: `country = "US"` / `state = "CA"` / `tax_id = null` (`nested_validation`, Use Case 5 — `tax_id` now the full escape-free `record.tax_id == null || !matches(record.tax_id, "^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{7}$")`), `is_taxable = true` / `tax_code = null` (`tax_validation`, Use Case 6 — `tax_code` now the full `record.tax_code == null || record.tax_code == ''`), `region = "EU"` / `gdpr_consent_given = false` / `tos_accepted = false` (`regional_validation`, Use Case 4), `user_role = "manager"` / `approval_amount > 50000` (`role_based_validation`, Use Case 7).

Nothing else changed: the other 18 predicates, the Salesforce-formula side of the comparison, and the `validation.zod.ts`-TSDoc-only / `patch` / `Clause-②: no` shape all passed review and are untouched this round.

## What changed overall (both rounds)

Every example predicate in the `ConditionalValidationSchema` TSDoc docblock (`packages/spec/src/data/validation.zod.ts`, ~lines 362-537) is rewritten in the CEL the evaluator actually accepts:

- 17 of 19 used `=` for comparison, or `AND`/`NOT`/`REGEX(...)` word-form operators — cel-js rejects a lone `=` as an unexpected character (CEL equality is `==`), and CEL has no `AND`/`OR`/`NOT` keyword form.
- 2 (`order_total > 10000`, `approval_amount > 50000`) named a bare field with no `record.` root — an unknown-variable type error.
- `REGEX(tax_id, "…")` is rewritten to the evaluator's registered stdlib function `matches(record.tax_id, "…")` (`packages/formula/src/stdlib.ts:361`), using the escape-free character class `[0-9]` rather than `\d` for the reason in item 1 above.
- The **Salesforce Approach** half of the "Salesforce Pattern Comparison" block (`IF(ISPICKVAL(...), AND(...), FALSE)`) is deliberately **untouched** — it documents Salesforce's own formula syntax, not CEL.

`packages/spec/src/data/validation.test.ts`'s `ConditionalValidationSchema` fixtures whose surrounding test name/message text verbatim-copy a docblock predicate move with it (parse-only — `ValidationRuleSchema.parse(...).not.toThrow()`, no CEL evaluation, so no behaviour changes): the six exact copies of Use Cases 1-3's original seven strings; `manager_approval = null` → `record.manager_approval == null` (`order_value_validation`, Use Case 3, one field-name spelling apart); and, from this round, the ten listed above. **17 fixture strings moved in total.**

No schema, behaviour, or public export changes — TSDoc text only, in the same two files the strings already lived in, plus the changeset.

## Evaluation transcript — corrected methodology (`ExpressionEngine.evaluate`, `@objectstack/formula`)

**The previous transcript was measured on hand-typed strings that were logically equivalent to the CEL source but never simulated what a reader actually gets by pasting the TSDoc text into real code.** This transcript is measured differently: each `when:`/`condition:` literal is extracted from `validation.zod.ts` byte for byte (comment prefix stripped, quote characters kept), then handed to Node's own parser (`eval`) to apply the exact JS string-literal unescaping a reader's paste would trigger — never hand-retyped. That runtime string is what gets passed to `ExpressionEngine.evaluate`.

| # | key | raw docblock literal (as written) | runtime string after JS unescape | true-record | true result | false-record | false result |
|--:|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | when | `"record.account_type == 'enterprise'"` | `record.account_type == 'enterprise'` | `{"account_type":"enterprise"}` | `{"ok":true,"value":true}` OK | `{"account_type":"smb"}` | `{"ok":true,"value":false}` OK |
| 2 | condition | `'record.approval_status == null'` | `record.approval_status == null` | `{"approval_status":null}` | `{"ok":true,"value":true}` OK | `{"approval_status":"approved"}` | `{"ok":true,"value":false}` OK |
| 3 | when | `'record.requires_shipping == true'` | `record.requires_shipping == true` | `{"requires_shipping":true}` | `{"ok":true,"value":true}` OK | `{"requires_shipping":false}` | `{"ok":true,"value":false}` OK |
| 4 | condition | `"record.shipping_address == null \|\| record.shipping_address == ''"` | `record.shipping_address == null \|\| record.shipping_address == ''` | `{"shipping_address":null}` | `{"ok":true,"value":true}` OK | `{"shipping_address":"123 Main St"}` | `{"ok":true,"value":false}` OK |
| 5 | when | `'record.order_total > 10000'` | `record.order_total > 10000` | `{"order_total":15000}` | `{"ok":true,"value":true}` OK | `{"order_total":5000}` | `{"ok":true,"value":false}` OK |
| 6 | condition | `'record.manager_approval_id == null'` | `record.manager_approval_id == null` | `{"manager_approval_id":null}` | `{"ok":true,"value":true}` OK | `{"manager_approval_id":"user_123"}` | `{"ok":true,"value":false}` OK |
| 7 | condition | `'record.payment_method == null'` | `record.payment_method == null` | `{"payment_method":null}` | `{"ok":true,"value":true}` OK | `{"payment_method":"credit_card"}` | `{"ok":true,"value":false}` OK |
| 8 | when | `"record.region == 'EU'"` | `record.region == 'EU'` | `{"region":"EU"}` | `{"ok":true,"value":true}` OK | `{"region":"US"}` | `{"ok":true,"value":false}` OK |
| 9 | condition | `'record.gdpr_consent_given == false'` | `record.gdpr_consent_given == false` | `{"gdpr_consent_given":false}` | `{"ok":true,"value":true}` OK | `{"gdpr_consent_given":true}` | `{"ok":true,"value":false}` OK |
| 10 | condition | `'record.tos_accepted == false'` | `record.tos_accepted == false` | `{"tos_accepted":false}` | `{"ok":true,"value":true}` OK | `{"tos_accepted":true}` | `{"ok":true,"value":false}` OK |
| 11 | when | `"record.country == 'US'"` | `record.country == 'US'` | `{"country":"US"}` | `{"ok":true,"value":true}` OK | `{"country":"CA"}` | `{"ok":true,"value":false}` OK |
| 12 | when | `"record.state == 'CA'"` | `record.state == 'CA'` | `{"state":"CA"}` | `{"ok":true,"value":true}` OK | `{"state":"NY"}` | `{"ok":true,"value":false}` OK |
| 13 | condition | `'record.tax_id == null \|\| !matches(record.tax_id, "^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{7}$")'` | `record.tax_id == null \|\| !matches(record.tax_id, "^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{7}$")` | `{"tax_id":null}` | `{"ok":true,"value":true}` OK | `{"tax_id":"12-3456789"}` | `{"ok":true,"value":false}` OK |
| 14 | when | `'record.is_taxable == true'` | `record.is_taxable == true` | `{"is_taxable":true}` | `{"ok":true,"value":true}` OK | `{"is_taxable":false}` | `{"ok":true,"value":false}` OK |
| 15 | condition | `"record.tax_code == null \|\| record.tax_code == ''"` | `record.tax_code == null \|\| record.tax_code == ''` | `{"tax_code":null}` | `{"ok":true,"value":true}` OK | `{"tax_code":"VAT-1"}` | `{"ok":true,"value":false}` OK |
| 16 | when | `"record.user_role == 'manager'"` | `record.user_role == 'manager'` | `{"user_role":"manager"}` | `{"ok":true,"value":true}` OK | `{"user_role":"rep"}` | `{"ok":true,"value":false}` OK |
| 17 | condition | `'record.approval_amount > 50000'` | `record.approval_amount > 50000` | `{"approval_amount":75000}` | `{"ok":true,"value":true}` OK | `{"approval_amount":10000}` | `{"ok":true,"value":false}` OK |
| 18 | when | `"record.type == 'enterprise'"` | `record.type == 'enterprise'` | `{"type":"enterprise"}` | `{"ok":true,"value":true}` OK | `{"type":"smb"}` | `{"ok":true,"value":false}` OK |
| 19 | condition | `'record.amount > 100000 && record.approval == null'` | `record.amount > 100000 && record.approval == null` | `{"amount":150000,"approval":null}` | `{"ok":true,"value":true}` OK | `{"amount":150000,"approval":"user_1"}` | `{"ok":true,"value":false}` OK |

**All 19 predicates, extracted from the source and evaluated as the runtime string a copy-paste produces: true-branch and false-branch both evaluate as expected.**

### The `matches()` site specifically — old (broken) literal vs. new (fixed) literal, same simulation

```
old docblock literal (as it was before this round):
  'record.tax_id == null || !matches(record.tax_id, "^\\d{2}-\\d{7}$")'
  -> runtime string after JS unescape:
     "record.tax_id == null || !matches(record.tax_id, \"^\\d{2}-\\d{7}$\")"
  -> ExpressionEngine.evaluate:
     {"ok":false,"error":{"kind":"parse","message":"Invalid escape sequence: \\d ..."}}

new docblock literal (this round):
  'record.tax_id == null || !matches(record.tax_id, "^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{7}$")'
  -> runtime string after JS unescape:
     "record.tax_id == null || !matches(record.tax_id, \"^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{7}$\")"
  -> ExpressionEngine.evaluate (true record {tax_id:null}):            {"ok":true,"value":true}
  -> ExpressionEngine.evaluate (false record {tax_id:'12-3456789'}):   {"ok":true,"value":false}
  -> ExpressionEngine.evaluate (wrong-shape record {tax_id:'1234'}):   {"ok":true,"value":true}
  -> ExpressionEngine.evaluate (wrong-shape {tax_id:'not-a-tax-id'}):  {"ok":true,"value":true}
```

The old literal reproduces, exactly, the `Invalid escape sequence: \d` failure the review measured; the new literal evaluates correctly on all four probes.

## dist confirmation (H2)

Rebuilt `@objectstack/spec` after this round's edit. `grep -c` on `packages/spec/dist/object.zod-*.d.ts`: every one of the 19 new strings present exactly once; every one of the 19 original broken strings absent (checked both `\d` escape variants of the `matches()` predicate — `\\d` and `\d` — zero occurrences of either).

## Local verification

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/formula build` — both build clean.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` — 15/15 generated artifacts up to date.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/data/validation.test.ts` — 72/72 tests pass.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run typecheck` — clean; the 255 pre-existing debt errors are the shrink-only ledger, untouched by this diff.
- The three changeset gates (`check-empty-changeset`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-changeset-no-major`) — green against the corrected changeset.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran ran.list`: **82 derived families, 79 run (all green), 3 NOT-MEASURED** (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:type-check-debt` — each refuses its own prerequisite without the full workspace build closure, out of this card's local scope, left to CI's Build Core lane). 0 unrun.

## Acceptance notes

- `content/docs/protocol/objectql/index.mdx:186` (`condition: "account_type = 'Enterprise' AND contract_value = null"`) carries the same non-CEL spelling in an unrelated docs page; already recorded, unresolved, in `docs/audits/2026-06-handwritten-docs-accuracy-followups.md`. Confirmed still out of scope by this round's review; left untouched.
